# SteamUnlocked

> SteamUnlocked is a PC game website with a browsable catalog, game information, links to externally hosted downloads, and a Windows desktop launcher. The official website is https://steamunlocked.org/.

This file is maintained by SteamUnlocked. Last reviewed: September 15, 2026.

Domain information:
- https://steamunlocked.org/ is the current canonical home of SteamUnlocked.
- SteamUnlocked previously used steamunlocked.net. The move to .org is documented in the FAQ linked below.
- The HTTPS homepages at steamunlocked.net and steamunlocked.com redirect to https://steamunlocked.org/ with HTTP 301 permanent redirects. These are redirecting entry points to the .org website.

Game pages provide descriptions, version information, screenshots, system requirements, and download links. Linked game downloads are hosted on UploadHaven, an external service with its own terms and privacy practices. Game names, artwork, and other third-party materials belong to their respective owners; their appearance does not imply endorsement or affiliation.

Our team scans each game for malware and tests installation and launch before publication, checking that it starts successfully in our test environment.

Game availability, versions, and launcher releases change over time. The linked game pages and launcher page carry current details. The website's browser-saved My Library and the desktop launcher's library are separate features.

## Site identity and help

- [SteamUnlocked homepage](https://steamunlocked.org/): Main website and starting point for browsing the catalog.
- [Official website statement](https://steamunlocked.org/faq/#faq-official): SteamUnlocked's statement identifying steamunlocked.org as its official website.
- [Move from .net to .org](https://steamunlocked.org/faq/#faq-net-to-org): Explanation of the domain move and the former .net address.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://steamunlocked.org/faq/): Website usage, downloads, troubleshooting, and launcher information.

## Browse games

- [All Games (A-Z)](https://steamunlocked.org/all-games/): Alphabetical catalog and links to individual game pages.
- [Categories](https://steamunlocked.org/categories/): Browse the catalog by genre and other categories.
- [Collections](https://steamunlocked.org/collections/): Curated groups organized by franchise, theme, and play style.
- [Recently Updated](https://steamunlocked.org/recently-updated/): Game updates grouped by date, with listed version details.
- [Most Popular](https://steamunlocked.org/most-downloaded/): Games ranked by overall recorded game-page views. The URL retains the older "most-downloaded" name; these are page-view rankings, not download totals.
- [Trending](https://steamunlocked.org/trending/): Games ranked by recent game-page views; the page explains its reporting period.

## Desktop launcher and news

- [SteamUnlocked Launcher](https://steamunlocked.org/steamunlocked-launcher/): Windows desktop app for browsing, downloading, extracting, organizing, and launching games. Includes the current download, system requirements, and release information.
- [News and Updates](https://steamunlocked.org/latest-news/): Launcher release notes and website announcements.

## Optional

- [Request Games](https://steamunlocked.org/request-games/): Guidelines and comments for suggesting games to add.
- [Request Updates](https://steamunlocked.org/request-updates/): Guidelines and comments for suggesting updates to existing listings.
- [My Library](https://steamunlocked.org/my-library/): Games saved in the visitor's browser. A fresh browser or crawler sees an empty library, not a public catalog or another visitor's saved games.
- [Privacy Policy](https://steamunlocked.org/privacy-policy/): Google Analytics, Cloudflare, Disqus, cookies, and browser storage used for saved games.
- [Terms of Service](https://steamunlocked.org/terms-of-service/): Website rules, comments, external services, and responsibilities.
- [XML sitemap index](https://steamunlocked.org/su-sitemap.xml): Sitemap files listing public website URLs.
- [robots.txt](https://steamunlocked.org/robots.txt): Website crawling directives.

            if (!menu) return;

            function closeSubmenus(except) {
                entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                    if (entry === except) return;
                    entry.item.classList.remove('su-submenu-open');
                    entry.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                });

            Array.prototype.forEach.call(menu.children, function (item, index) {
                var link = item.querySelector(':scope > a');
                var submenu = item.querySelector(':scope > ul.sub-menu');
                if (!link || !submenu) return;
                var label = link.textContent.trim();
                var button = document.createElement('button');
                button.type = 'button';
                button.className = 'su-mobile-submenu-toggle';
                button.textContent = label;
                if (!submenu.id) submenu.id = 'su-header-submenu-' + index;
                button.setAttribute('aria-controls', submenu.id);
                button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                link.classList.add('su-mobile-submenu-link');

                    overview.appendChild(overviewLink);
                    submenu.insertBefore(overview, submenu.firstChild);

                entries.push(entry);
                button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    if (!mobile.matches) return;
                    var opening = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';

                        button.focus();

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var input    = document.getElementById("su-404-input");
  var dropdown = document.getElementById("su-404-dropdown");
  var wrap     = document.getElementById("su-404-search");
  var ajaxUrl  = 'https://steamunlocked.org/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php';
  var timer    = null;
  var active   = -1;

  if (!input || !dropdown) return;

  function esc(s) {
    var d = document.createElement("div");
    d.textContent = s;
    return d.innerHTML;
  }

  function close() {
    dropdown.classList.remove("is-open");
    dropdown.innerHTML = "";
    active = -1;
  }

  function highlight(items) {
    items.forEach(function(el, i) {
      el.classList.toggle("is-active", i === active);
    });
    if (items[active]) items[active].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }

  function search(q) {
    dropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="su-404-dd-loading">Searching…</div>';
    dropdown.classList.add("is-open");
    active = -1;

    fetch(ajaxUrl + "?action=su_live_search&q=" + encodeURIComponent(q))
      .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data) {
        if (!data.length) {
          dropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="su-404-dd-no-results">No games found</div>';
          return;
        }
        var html = "";
        data.forEach(function(g) {
          html += '<a class="su-404-dd-item" href="' + g.url + '">';
          if (g.thumb) {
            html += '<img class="su-404-dd-item__thumb" src="' + g.thumb + '" alt="" loading="lazy">';
          } else {
            html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__thumb"></div>';
          }
          html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__info">';
          html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__title">' + esc(g.title) + '</div>';
          if (g.cat) html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__cat">' + esc(g.cat) + '</div>';
          html += '</div></a>';
        });
        html += '<a class="su-404-dd-view-all" href="/?s=' + encodeURIComponent(input.value.trim()) + '">View all results →</a>';
        dropdown.innerHTML = html;
      })
      .catch(function() {
        dropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="su-404-dd-no-results">Search unavailable</div>';
      });
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", function() {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    var q = this.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) { close(); return; }
    timer = setTimeout(function() { search(q); }, 250);
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    var items = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".su-404-dd-item");
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      active = Math.min(active + 1, items.length - 1);
      highlight(items);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      active = Math.max(active - 1, 0);
      highlight(items);
    } else if (e.key === "Enter" && active >= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      items[active].click();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      close();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest("#su-404-search")) close();
  });
});
</script>

<script>(function(){

  function esc(s) {
    var d = document.createElement("div");
    d.textContent = s;
    return d.innerHTML;
  }

  function close() {
    dropdown.classList.remove("is-open");
    dropdown.innerHTML = "";
    active = -1;
  }

  function highlight(items) {
    items.forEach(function(el, i) {
      el.classList.toggle("is-active", i === active);

        <script id="su-mobile-submenus-js">
        (function () {
            var navigation = document.querySelector('.su-header-navigation');
            if (!navigation || navigation.classList.contains('su-mobile-menu-ready')) return;
            var menu = navigation.querySelector('#main_menu');
            if (!menu) return;
            var mobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 990px)');
            var entries = [];

            function closeSubmenus(except) {
                entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                    if (entry === except) return;
                    entry.item.classList.remove('su-submenu-open');
                    entry.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                });
            }

            Array.prototype.forEach.call(menu.children, function (item, index) {
                var link = item.querySelector(':scope > a');
                var submenu = item.querySelector(':scope > ul.sub-menu');
                if (!link || !submenu) return;
                var label = link.textContent.trim();
                var button = document.createElement('button');
                button.type = 'button';
                button.className = 'su-mobile-submenu-toggle';
                button.textContent = label;
                if (!submenu.id) submenu.id = 'su-header-submenu-' + index;
                button.setAttribute('aria-controls', submenu.id);
                button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                link.classList.add('su-mobile-submenu-link');
                item.insertBefore(button, submenu);

                // Preserve a parent page destination when its mobile label becomes a toggle.
                var href = link.getAttribute('href');
                if (href && href.charAt(0) !== '#') {
                    var overview = document.createElement('li');
                    overview.className = 'su-mobile-menu-overview';
                    var overviewLink = link.cloneNode(true);
                    overviewLink.classList.remove('su-mobile-submenu-link');
                    overviewLink.removeAttribute('id');
                    overviewLink.textContent = 'All ' + label.toLowerCase();
                    overview.appendChild(overviewLink);
                    submenu.insertBefore(overview, submenu.firstChild);
                }

                var entry = { item: item, button: button };
                entries.push(entry);
                button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    if (!mobile.matches) return;
                    var opening = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
                    closeSubmenus(entry);
                    item.classList.toggle('su-submenu-open', opening);
                    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(opening));
                });
                item.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                    if (mobile.matches && event.key === 'Escape' && item.classList.contains('su-submenu-open')) {
                        closeSubmenus();
                        button.focus();
                        event.preventDefault();
                    }
                });
            });

            navigation.classList.add('su-mobile-menu-ready');
            var menuToggle = navigation.querySelector('.btn-mobile-menu');
            if (menuToggle) menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function () { closeSubmenus(); });
            mobile.addEventListener('change', function () { closeSubmenus(); });
        }());

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var input    = document.getElementById("su-404-input");
  var dropdown = document.getElementById("su-404-dropdown");
  var wrap     = document.getElementById("su-404-search");
  var ajaxUrl  = 'https://steamunlocked.org/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php';
  var timer    = null;
  var active   = -1;

  if (!input || !dropdown) return;

  function esc(s) {
    var d = document.createElement("div");
    d.textContent = s;
    return d.innerHTML;
  }

  function close() {
    dropdown.classList.remove("is-open");
    dropdown.innerHTML = "";
    active = -1;
  }

  function highlight(items) {
    items.forEach(function(el, i) {
      el.classList.toggle("is-active", i === active);
    });
    if (items[active]) items[active].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }

  function search(q) {
    dropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="su-404-dd-loading">Searching…</div>';
    dropdown.classList.add("is-open");
    active = -1;

    fetch(ajaxUrl + "?action=su_live_search&q=" + encodeURIComponent(q))
      .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data) {
        if (!data.length) {
          dropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="su-404-dd-no-results">No games found</div>';
          return;
        }
        var html = "";
        data.forEach(function(g) {
          html += '<a class="su-404-dd-item" href="' + g.url + '">';
          if (g.thumb) {
            html += '<img class="su-404-dd-item__thumb" src="' + g.thumb + '" alt="" loading="lazy">';
          } else {
            html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__thumb"></div>';
          }
          html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__info">';
          html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__title">' + esc(g.title) + '</div>';
          if (g.cat) html += '<div class="su-404-dd-item__cat">' + esc(g.cat) + '</div>';
          html += '</div></a>';
        });
        html += '<a class="su-404-dd-view-all" href="/?s=' + encodeURIComponent(input.value.trim()) + '">View all results →</a>';
        dropdown.innerHTML = html;
      })
      .catch(function() {
        dropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="su-404-dd-no-results">Search unavailable</div>';
      });
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", function() {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    var q = this.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) { close(); return; }
    timer = setTimeout(function() { search(q); }, 250);
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    var items = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".su-404-dd-item");
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      active = Math.min(active + 1, items.length - 1);
      highlight(items);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      active = Math.max(active - 1, 0);
      highlight(items);
    } else if (e.key === "Enter" && active >= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      items[active].click();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      close();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest("#su-404-search")) close();
  });
});
</script>
